newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy slips nearbys, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy slips nearbys, wheat steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf soybean basis values slipped one cent a bushel for November positions while corn and wheat prices were mostly steady.
Exporters were expected to closely watch Thursday's weekly export sales report which may reveal Chinese soybean and soymeal business.
Strong indications filtered through the U.S. soybean market that China last week bought U.S. soybeans and soymeal and that China may also be seeking beans and meal this week.
"We might not catch all the Chinese business tomorrow (Thursday), but I think they did more business than what people originally thought," one U.S. exporter said.

"At least 400,000 tonnes in meal was done (in total) and and probably around 600,000 tonnes in beans," the exporter said. "We are waiting to see if its optional origin. But nobody knows for sure," the exporter said.
